reviews.decision: Constructor slot1 takes the public Injector token and forwards that exact supplied reference to slot1 of the locally owned dialog base. It does not construct an injector, select deprecated get/create overloads or dispose the supplied service. The base performs a one-token public get for the actual imported CDK Dialog token; that distinct peer dependency and dialog behavior remain separate review obligations. Whole authenticated original/current minimum Core namespaces preserve typed class/token lookup, cached supplied-instance identity, parent precedence and context restoration in72 public protocol checks and6 whole-module mutation rejections. Strict whole declarations compile with4 expected errors per subject and resolved valid calls select nondeprecated signatures. This is an exact Injector dependency/forwarding judgment, not automatic application/node/actual-dialog construction or complete product qualification. Cyph has no matching manual legacy service construction in the recorded source scan. No product or consumer TypeScript/HTML/CSS/SCSS repair is required.

Constructor slot2 takes the public Injector and forwards it unchanged to slot2 of the owned menu-content base alongside the caller-provided template/application/view/document/detector references. There is no static injector creation or new root application here. Whole authenticated original/current minimum Core namespaces preserve supplied instance, class/token retrieval, parent hierarchy and context behavior; object get/create contracts use nondeprecated public signatures, and the changed current create return is a narrower DestroyableInjector. The caller uses only the supplied Injector interface. The base later forwards it to the public portal outlet; current portal behavior and lazy view lifecycle are independent unclosed dependencies/gates. Source forwarding controls reject swapped arguments. This source/API boundary requires no consumer resources or API change, with Cyph static sanity retained; genuine Angular node creation, packed lazy menu and full floors remain unexecuted by this record.

Constructor slot2 receives the public Injector token and passes the same instance to slot2 of the local snack-bar base. No Root/child injection scope or provider is created by this wrapper, and it performs no destruction. Genuine original/minimum Core operations prove cached useValue/class-token identity, hierarchy, object options and successful/throwing context restoration; all3 strict complete declaration subjects pass and no valid fixture selects a deprecated overload. Source slot and receiver guards bind this exact forwarding behavior. The base value-only child configurations and their parent order are separately recorded in the companion per-use judgment; actual snack service/container/announcement/portal lifecycle is not discharged. No product API or HTML/CSS/SCSS change is needed, and no direct matching Cyph manual constructor use was found. Eleven post-seed Injector imports are explicitly inventoried pending their own review; this does not close them or G11.

The supplied constructor slot2 is retained as _injector. Two stable object-form Injector.create calls prioritize config.viewContainerRef.injector when present, falling back to the supplied service injector. One child aliases the existing config through MatSnackBarConfig; the other aliases the supplied snackBarRef and config.data through the actual public token/ref imports. Both children flow once to ComponentPortal argument2; the returned factory route and caller are source-bound and no child destroy/private/numeric-flags/deprecated-array path is accepted. Genuine original/minimum Core tests preserve parent preference and all supplied object identities. They also demonstrate a material ownership distinction: child destruction leaves inherited parent values alone, but destroying an injector after retrieving a locally registered useValue invokes that value ngOnDestroy hook. The owned code therefore does not gain speculative cleanup that could destroy caller values. This dependency/API and exact source ownership judgment does not prove portal/component lifetime or absence of retained views; those actual product paths remain pending. No source, API or consumer resource change is needed; all11 newer Injector uses and complete G11 remain pending.

Constructor slot2 stores the supplied Injector as a private parameter property and forwards that unchanged reference to argument2 of DomPortalOutlet. The owned base does not get/create/destroy the injector or create an application. Disposal here targets the portal outlet; this judgment does not substitute for the still-separate current portal implementation, template attachment, parent application ownership or lazy menu lifecycle review. Exact source guards record the only supplied receiver use and reject unknown members/aliases/argument shifts. Genuine original/current minimum public Core contracts retain the nondeprecated Injector interface, class/token identity and parent/context semantics; the narrower current create result is unused in this caller. Source and type evidence support the public Injector dependency/forwarding boundary while actual component/native/packed/floor gates remain pending. There is no required consumer TypeScript or resource repair.

The supplied constructor slot1 is used once in injector.get(Dialog), where Dialog is the actual named public import from @angular/cdk/dialog. Source guards reject numeric flags, extra get arguments, changed token routes or unknown member/ownership operations. Stable generic public get and class/token lookup are proven through the complete original/current minimum declarations and real Core modules; strict valid calls resolve nondeprecated signatures. This use does not create/destroy an injector and caches the resulting peer service in the existing owned _dialog field. CDK Dialog token availability, construction/open behavior, provider composition, focus/overlay teardown and actual legacy dialog integration remain separate pending contracts, rather than being inferred from protocol service values. No product or consumer API/HTML/CSS/SCSS change is required for this public Injector API binding, and all11 newer Injector dependencies remain separately pending.
